# langsmith_tunnel (Resource)

Manages an organization LangSmith tunnel, which lets LangSmith reach named services on your network. Run the connector with `langsmith tunnel connect <id>`. Import with `<id>`; personal connections are rejected.

Private network connections must be enabled for the organization, and the API key needs `organization:infrastructure:manage`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A tunnel lets LangSmith reach named services on your network. Run the
# connector with `langsmith tunnel connect <id> --target app=http://localhost:PORT`.
resource "langsmith_tunnel" "vpc" {
  name        = "vpc"
  description = "Services in the private VPC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Connection name, unique among the organization's tunnels and relays. Renaming updates in place.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection accepts traffic. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Tunnel ID; pass it to `langsmith tunnel connect`.
- `status` (String) Connector status reported by LangSmith: `pending`, `active` or `inactive`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langsmith_tunnel.example tunnel_id
```
